statement: In an abelian group, if r is odd, rP=0 and T is nonzero with 2T=0, then r(P+T)=T!=0; translation byT leaves the r-torsion subgroup.
scope: Individual translation P->P+T in the r-torsion domain.
assumptions: Abelian additive group; r odd;2T=0;T!=0; rP=0.
not_implied: Torsion-based methods cannot help on mixed domains.
Even translations of tuples change their total.
This is already a Lean theorem in this packet.
lesson: Check domain stability before claiming free orbit reduction; a T-closed mixed domain is a distinct live mechanism.
next_discriminating_test: Formalize the group lemma; construct quotient equations on an explicitly T-closed domain and verify lifts.
revisit_when: Formalize the group lemma; construct quotient equations on an explicitly T-closed domain and verify lifts.
